reasoning: Claim s1 is labelled proposed and offers no quote. E1, the development record, says lineage crews carry channel repair under a Special Draw Right from Book 20; outside apprentices are not stated in E1. The training condition appears in the cited items only in E3 and E7, both agent_proposed. E13 repeats E7 in Book 25, which is repetition, not corroboration. The if/could wording keeps the development conditional, so no modal misreading. Defensible as a proposal, but its load-bearing condition is not record.
quote: The Special Draw Right is conditional on training apprentices from outside the lineage.
alternative_reading: No quote is offered, so none is checked. E7 carries the training condition, but its attribution is agent_proposed and its parenthetical says the source gives a reversal for the review point, which does not confirm the condition. Read as record, 'the condition the Right carries' would take E7 as established; the attributions do not allow that.
would_settle: An established item stating that the Special Draw Right is conditional on training outside apprentices, or the author confirming that condition.
creative_room: Stays open as a proposal: what the lineage must carry, what the labour would mean, and how outside apprentices could test the Right. Treat the training condition as proposal, not record, unless an established item or the author states it. The lineage could also keep carrying the labour without any training condition, which E1 alone supports.
